Author: Kadamode
Name: Sell Everything
Punchline: Automatically price and liquidate marketable inventory through retainers.
Description: Starting from the retainer list, selects retainers and processes eligible inventory through the in-game Compare Prices flow. NQ items use only NQ listings and HQ items use only HQ listings. Matching prices below 100 gil are sold through the retainer; other items are listed one gil below the lowest matching offer. Includes protected-item rules, expected-dialog confirmation, strict request validation, and an emergency stop. Use /selleverything.
